download_llama2_tokenizer: run the python module to download the llama2 tokenizer model from HuggingFace Hub to a local directory
download_llama3_tokenizer: run the python module to download the llama3 tokenizer model from HuggingFace Hub to a local directory
download_gemma_tokenizer: run the python module to download the gemma tokenizer model from HuggingFace Hub to a local directory
download_tiktoken_encoding: run the python module to download a tiktoken encoding by name and cache it to a local directory
download_tokenizer_with_api_key: run the python module to download a private HuggingFace tokenizer using an API key for authentication
